class.brief_description: GameplayEditorDebuggerPlugin — Phase 4 Live Editor Debugger & Hardware/VR Simulator.
class.description: GameplayEditorDebuggerPlugin — Phase 4 Live Editor Debugger & Hardware/VR Simulator. Responsibilities: 1. Live Cascade Hot-Reload: Broadcasts `ideam_games:apply_style` and `ideam_games:apply_rule` packets to active EditorDebuggerSession instances and applies directly to edited scene nodes so tuning sliders or rules in the Inspector updates running/edited games in real time. 2. Hardware & VR Input Injector: Interactive test bench for sending synthetic Arduino/USB serial lines (`feed_custom_serial_line("AX:1023,AY:512,BTN1:1")`), 8/16-bit HID byte packets (`feed_custom_hid_bytes()`), and simulated VR 6DoF controller poses/velocities (`feed_vr_controller_state()`) without requiring physical hardware attached. Part of IdeamGames (game agents, players, rules, scoring, and match orchestration).
